issues.explanation: New mention validation, formatting, and truncation behavior ships with no Pest/PHPUnit test, violating TDD rule that every feature has a test.
CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] was not updated despite docs-freshness convention requiring it.
Comment says integer values are accepted but the is_string guard rejects integers, misleading future maintainers.
Mention length uses strlen while content truncation uses mb_substr, inconsistent though harmless because the mention is pure ASCII.

conventions.evidence: config/services.php:40 'mention_id' => env('DISCORD_MENTION_ID'), .env.example:10 DISCORD_MENTION_ID=, docs/ops updates follow sibling style; but no Pest test added despite conventions.md TDD 'No production code without a test', and CHANGELOG.md untouched

readability.evidence: Clear names mentionId/maxBaseLength and small formatContent method; nit at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:42 comment 'Accept integer values as strings' contradicts is_string check; strlen/mb_substr mix at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:75

requirements.evidence: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:43 trim + '/^\d{17,20}$/' rejects @everyone/@here/abc/123/embedded newlines; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:73 "\n<@{$mentionId}>" on own line; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:75-77 reserves room so mention survives and total stays MaxContentLength, unchanged without mention; config/services.php:40 + .env.example:10 + docs/ops/devops.md + docs/ops/logging.md

scope.evidence: All hunks serve the task: .env.example, config/services.php, app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php, docs/ops/devops.md, docs/ops/logging.md; no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: Strict allowlist on trimmed value with silent null fallback, safe interpolation of digits-only id, no change to webhook no-op/redaction/soft-fail logging, no Blade or Livewire surface

simplicity.evidence: Lean ~15-line change reusing formatContent and existing config, no new layers or abstractions; app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:52 passes ?string $mentionId through

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no test files and no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for valid/invalid mention ids, empty config, or truncation-with-mention survival

review.summary: Adds optional DISCORD_MENTION_ID ping with strict 17-20-digit validation and truncation that preserves the mention, plus config and docs. Functionally correct and scoped, but ships with no tests and has a misleading comment, so it needs changes before merging.
